note: This file is a configuration script for MMPretrain (MMEngine-based). It contains no functions, classes, or callable APIs — only variable assignments and configuration overrides imported via read_base(). No example statements can be generated.
read_base_usage: read base configuration files from MMPretrain _base_ directories to inherit dataset, model, schedule, and runtime settings
EMAHook_config: configure EMAHook with momentum and priority settings for exponential moving average during training
train_dataloader_override: override the train dataloater batch size from the base configuration
optim_wrapper_override: override the optimizer learning rate and gradient clipping settings from the base configuration
auto_scale_lr_override: override the base batch size used for automatic learning rate scaling across GPUs
